# gigahost_servers (Data Source)

Returns all servers on your gigahost.no account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gigahost_servers" "example" {}

output "server_ids" {
  value = [for s in data.gigahost_servers.example.servers : s.id]
}
```
